gem-agent v0.0.0-characterize — scripted-main
instructions: AGENTS.md
skills: 1 (/skills)
sandbox: DISABLED — shell commands run unconfined; restart with the sandbox enabled to confine them
/help for commands, Ctrl+D to quit

> 
> commands:
  /help      show this help
  /tools     list tools and each one's current approval gate
  /mcp       list connected MCP servers (/mcp reload reconnects · /mcp load <server> loads one)
  /auto      auto-approve: on|off, or bare to toggle (shift+tab too)
  /readonly  read-only: on|off · auto on|off arms the watcher · bare shows both
  /thinking  thinking level for this session: minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|default · bare shows it
  /add-dir <path>   add a directory outside the project, written like the project (this process only)
  /read-dir <path>  add a directory outside the project, read only (this process only)
  /dirs      list the project, the work directory and the added directories
  /compact   summarise the older half of the conversation
  /settings  view and edit settings, with provenance
  /riskbook  view the risk rules; /riskbook learn drafts them from your answers
  /show <path>   draw an image in this terminal (the model uses show_image for the same thing)
  /usage     token statement for this session
  /memory    list persisted memories
  /skills    list installed skills (/skills reload re-discovers)
  /skill <name> [args]   invoke a skill directly
  /version   version and platform
  /clear     reset the conversation
  /quit      exit (/exit and Ctrl+D too)

attach:
  @<path>      a project file or directory (Tab completes)
  @<image>     images may also use absolute or ~ paths (@~/Desktop/shot.png)
  @clipboard   the clipboard image

shell:
  !<command>   run directly — sandboxed, no approval, output shared with the model

keys:
  Enter send · up/down history · Ctrl+C interrupt/clear · Ctrl+D quit
  Ctrl+J or a trailing \ inserts a newline; a multi-line paste stays one message
  typing during a turn queues the text (! and / cannot be queued)
  approval dialog: arrows/Tab select · Enter confirm · y/n/N/a/p direct (N = deny with a reason)

> main loop (scripted-main):
  rounds 1 · prompt 100 · output 10 · thoughts 0
  cached 0 of prompt (0%)
  context now 100 of 1.0M window (0%)

>   demo                     [project] A demonstration skill.
invoke with /skill <name> [arguments]; the model can also load them itself when the task matches

> mcp reloaded: 0 server(s), 0 tool(s)
history cleared — the next message starts a fresh conversation

> skills reloaded: 1 found
  demo                     [project] A demonstration skill.
invoke with /skill <name> [arguments]; the model can also load them itself when the task matches

> mcp reloaded: 0 server(s), 0 tool(s)

> 
> bye

Overwriting an existing file regenerates ALL of it from your context — never do that unless you have read the whole file in this conversation after any compaction; everything you do not reproduce verbatim is destroyed.\n- Keep changes minimal and focused on what the user asked.\n- Every approval-gated tool takes a \"gem_agent_purpose\" argument, and the user reads it on the approval prompt.
